hypotheses.construction_plan: Start with the template K(n)*f(n), where f is a placeholder function. Substitute f by a to get the first term; substitute f by b to get the second term. The original expression is then the sum of these two generated terms.
required_assumptions: a(n) and b(n) are arbitrary expressions in n
multiplication distributes over addition if treating the sum
K(n) is a common kernel factor
hypotheses.rationale: Structural observation F01 reports the two products K(n)*a(n) and K(n)*b(n) as AC-equivalent and as substitution instances of a frozen LGG template theta0*K(n) with holes a(n) and b(n). This matches a parameterized family in the placeholder function f, with K(n) as a fixed kernel.
